fieldValues.title: Field transclusion in Compositions
fieldValues.content: Pulling a specific Field value inline into a Composition is useful, but a syntax such as `{{field:{recordId}/{fieldId}}}` makes a reusable Composition depend on concrete instance IDs. That weakens portability and should wait for an addressing model that can express reusable selection rules rather than binding a definition to one Record.
